assertions.name: a read-only role cannot record a backup treatment
a recorded treatment waits for approval
an administrator without approval rights cannot approve it
a second person approves it and it becomes current
the recorder cannot approve their own treatment
the erasures are verified on both systems
only the system with a current treatment gets ledger rows, one per person, ageing out after 35 days
an administrator who may not read the ledger still sees true counts
the system without a treatment is unknown backup handling
Operations attention names the unknown backup handling, or states that more systems exist than it lists
the ledger itself needs sensitive access
the owner reads the ledger
a restore from a backup taken after the erasures marks nobody
a restore from a backup older than the erasures marks everyone erased since
Operations attention shows the re-erasure
an administrator cannot confirm re-erasure (sensitive)
the owner confirms one re-erasure with evidence
confirming it twice is refused
a treatment's recorded facts cannot be rewritten
a live ledger row cannot be deleted
the runner ages out and purges a row 30 days past its clear date
rows still within their backups are untouched by the sweep
the purge records the latest erasure it removed for that system, without naming anyone
a restore from a backup older than purged erasures is recorded, with INCOMPLETE ledger coverage and the purge point
the person whose re-erasure was confirmed is marked again
everyone the ledger can still name is marked for re-erasure
a restore from a backup taken after the purged erasures keeps COMPLETE coverage
Operations attention names the restore for a manual review
the complete restore is not flagged
the restore list shows it among unreviewed INCOMPLETE restores
an auditor cannot record the review
a complete restore takes no review
an unknown restore is 404
the manual review is recorded with the restore
expected: Restored tables compared against the erasure audit export by DBA pair (synthetic).
actual: Restored tables compared against the erasure audit export by DBA pair (synthetic).

assertions.name: a second review is refused
once reviewed, the restore leaves Operations attention
the review cannot be rewritten
the coverage of a recorded restore cannot be changed
one boundary is recorded for a system whose treatment predates the upgrade by more than 30 days, naming no one
recording the boundary again adds nothing for that system
a restore from before the upgrade boundary is INCOMPLETE, not reported as complete
a restore from after the boundary stays COMPLETE
the application role cannot record a boundary
purge records cannot be removed

limitation: Connector effects are exercised against the synthetic records test adapter; no live customer system was contacted.
